_comment: ADC values for an EPCOS 100K B57560G104F thermistor with the default 4700-ohm pullup, on an atmega2560 (ADC_MAX=1023 * SAMPLE_COUNT=8 -> max raw value 8184). 7817 corresponds to ~25 C, 7205 to ~50 C, 4699 to ~100 C. The fixture cycles through these so klippy's smoothed temperature converges to a sensible reading.
